statement: When treasury is constrained, opportunities that can be validated with zero media spend and minimal irreversible spend should outrank higher-upside but capital-intensive tests.
falsifier: Zero-capital lane repeatedly produces lower risk-adjusted return than small paid tests after comparable sample sizes.

statement: For giftable/specialist commerce, Google free listings, marketplace search, Pinterest organic and long-tail SEO can generate enough signal to select winners before paid acquisition.
falsifier: Products with strong free/organic signal do not outperform randomly selected products in subsequent paid tests.

statement: Personalization increases willingness to pay and reduces direct price comparability enough to support healthier contribution margins than generic commodity resale.
falsifier: Personalized variants fail to improve contribution after added production/support costs.

statement: AI is defensible when it creates bespoke output, compatibility, curation, visualization or service quality that would be costly manually; generic AI copy/design is not a moat.
falsifier: Bespoke AI variants do not beat high-quality static templates.

statement: Products with large visual-variant surfaces benefit disproportionately from Pinterest/Images/Lens because AI can cheaply produce high-quality contextual creative variations.
falsifier: Creative volume fails to produce incremental organic impressions or winners after quality controls.

statement: Marketplace-native demand (Etsy/eBay/Amazon Handmade) is a cheaper validation surface than launching an unknown standalone store; proven offers should graduate to owned specialist sites.
falsifier: Owned-site validation costs less or converts better from cold start across repeated launches.

statement: High-intent search/discovery surfaces outperform interruption ads for low-capital specialist commerce.
falsifier: Cold social acquisition consistently beats search/marketplace/free discovery on contribution after creative costs.

statement: Narrow expert storefronts with useful decision tools convert better than generic multi-category stores.
falsifier: Generic control stores perform equally or better under matched traffic/offer conditions.

statement: Localized specialist execution in affluent smaller markets can offer better competition-adjusted economics than English-first global competition.
falsifier: Localization costs and smaller demand erase the competition advantage.

statement: Giftability materially raises Q4 conversion and AOV for products that can be recipient-framed, bundled or personalized.
falsifier: Gift framing does not produce seasonal lift versus matched evergreen messaging.

statement: Experiments can remain positive-EV when failed offers generate reusable code, creative, data, SEO pages or market intelligence.
falsifier: Experiment exhaust is rarely reused or has negligible downstream value.
